text.body:
<1> lakṣmīṃ tanotu nitarāmitarānapekṣamaṅghridvayaṃ nigamaśākhiśikhāpravālam | hairambamamburuhaḍambaracauryanighnaṃ vighnādribhedaśatadhāradhurandharaṃ naḥ ||1|| uccairgatirjagati siddhyati dharmataścet tasya pramā ca vacanaiḥ kṛtaketaraiścet | teṣāṃ prakāśanadaśā ca mahīsuraiścet tānantareṇa nipatet kva nu matpraṇāmaḥ ||2|| gadyānubandharasamiśritapadyasūktiḥ hṛdyā hi vādyakalayā kaliteva gītiḥ | tasmāddadhātu kavimārgajuṣāṃ sukhāya campūprabandharacanāṃ rasanā madīyā ||3|| vālmīkigītaraghupuṅgavakīrtileśaistṛptiṃ karomi kathamapyadhunā budhānām | gaṅgājalairbhuvi bhagīrathayatnalabdhaiḥ kiṃ tarpaṇaṃ na vidadhāti naraḥ pitṝṇām ||4|| vācaṃ niśamya bhagavān sa tu nāradasya prācetasaḥ pravacasāṃ prathamaḥ kavīnām | mādhyandināya niyamāya maharṣisevyāṃ puṇyāmavāpa tamasāṃ tamasāṃ nihantrīm ||5|| tatra kañcana krauñcamithunādekaṃ pañcaśaraviddhamapi vyādhenānuviddhaṃ nidhyāyato baddhānukampasya bhagavato vālmīkervadanāravindācchandomayī kācidevaṃ niḥsasāra sarasvatī mā niṣāda pratiṣṭhāṃ tvamagamaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | yatkauñcamithunādekamavadhīḥ kāmamohitam ||6|| tadanu samayocitakṛtyaṃ virvartya svāśramaṃ prati gatavati bhagavati vālmīkau, vāṇīvilāsamaparatra kṛtopalambhammbhojabhūrasahamāna ivāvirāsīt | ābhāti yatkṛtiranekavidhaprapañcavyājendrajālavidhisādhakapiñchikeva ||7|| tataḥ paramaharṣeṇa maharṣiṇā vidhivadabhyarcitaḥ parameṣṭhī madhyamaloke'pi svavṛttaṃ prakāśayituṃ kila bhavantamevopatiṣṭhamānayānayā bhāratyā rāmacaritaṃ yathāśrutaṃ vyākriyatāmiti vyāhṛtyāntaradhāt | atha sarasijayonerājñayā rāmavṛttaṃ karabadarasamānaṃ prekṣya dṛṣṭyā pratīcyā | śubhamatanuta kāvyaṃ svādu rāmāyaṇākhyaṃ madhumayaphaṇitīnāṃ mārgadarśī maharṣiḥ ||8|| enaṃ prabandhaṃ prayoktuṃ kaḥ samartha iti cintāmupagatavati sati bhagavati vālmīkau, upāgatau militaparasparopamau bahuśrutau śrutimadhurasvarānvitau | vicakṣaṇau vividhanarendralakṣaṇau kuśīlavau kuśalavanāmadhāriṇau ||9|| etau muniḥ parigṛhya svāṃ kṛtimapāṭhayat | tau punaritastato gāyamānau dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ prahṛṣṭamanāḥ svabhavanamānīya bhrātṛbhiḥ parivṛto nijacaritaṃ gātumanvayuṅkta | tataśca chandomayīnāṃ nilayasya vācāmantevasantau munipuṅgavasya | etau kumārau raghuvīravṛttaṃ yathākramaṃ gātumupākrametām ||10|| asti praśastā janalocanānāmānandasandāyiṣu kosaleṣu | ājñāsamutsāritadānavānāṃ rājñāmayodhyeti purī raghūṇām ||11|| tāmāvasaddaśarathaḥ suravanditena saṅkrandanena vihitāsanasaṃvibhāgaḥ | vṛndārakārivijaye suralokalabdhamandāramālyamadhuvāsitavāsabhūmiḥ ||12|| athāsminnanapatyatayā dūyamānamānase putrārthaṃ kratumaśvamedhaṃ vidhātuṃ mantribhiḥ samaṃ mantrayamāṇe daśarathe sumantraḥ prahṛṣṭamanā maharṣeraṅgadeśasaṅgatāvagrahanigrahaśauṇḍasya vibhāṇḍakasūnoravaśyamṛṣyaśṛṅgasya prasādātprabhavo bhavitā kumārāṇāmiti sanatkumārodīritaṃ purāvṛttamasmai daśarathāya kathayāmāsa | so'pi sumantravacanācchāntādhiḥ śāntākuṭumbinaṃ sambandhinaṃ munimānīya vasiṣṭhādiṣṭamaśvamedhādhvaraṃ sarayūrodhasi vidhāya tatra putrīyāmiṣṭiṃ vidhivatkartumārabhata | tadanu havirāharaṇāya dharaṇau kṛtāvataraṇāḥ sarve gīrvāṇagaṇāḥ śatamakhapramukhāścaturmukhāya daśamukhapratāpagrīṣmoṣmasamploṣaṇamāvedya tena saha śaraṇamiti śārṅgadhanvānaṃ manvānā nānāvidhaprastutastutayaḥ kṣīrāmburāśimāseduḥ | santāpaghnaṃ sakalajagatāṃ śārṅgacāpābhirāmaṃ lakṣmīvidyullasitamatasīgucchasacchāyakāyam | vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ munijanamanaścātakānāṃ śaraṇyaṃ kāruṇyāpaṃ tridaśapariṣatkālameghaṃ dadarśa ||13|| kṣīrāmbhodherjaṭharamabhito dehabhāsāṃ prarohaiḥ kālonmīlatkuvalayadalādvaitamāpādayantam | ātanvānaṃ bhujagaśayane kāmapi kṣaumagaure nidrāmudrāṃ nikhilajagatīrakṣaṇe jāgarūkām ||14|| prahlādasya vyasanamamitaṃ daityavargasya dambhaṃ stambhaṃ vakṣaḥsthalamapi riporyaugapadyena bhettum | baddhaśraddhaṃ puruṣavapuṣā miśrite viśvadṛṣṭe daṃṣṭrārocirviśadabhuvane raṃhasā siṃhaveṣe ||15|| nārāyaṇāya nalināyatalocanāya nāmāvaśeṣitamahābalivaibhavāya | nānācarācaravidhāyakajanmadeśanābhīpuṭāya puruṣāya namaḥ parasmai ||16|| iti praṇamyotthitānetān stutiravamukharitaharinmukhān harihayapramukhānakhilānamarānaruṇāruṇatāmarasavilāsacorairlocanamarīcisantānairānandayannaravindalocanaḥ sphuṭamabhāṣata | api kuśalamamartyāḥ svāgataṃ sāmprataṃ vaḥ śamitadanujadambhā kiṃ nu dambholikeliḥ | api dhiṣaṇamanīṣānirmitā nītimārgāḥ tridaśanagarayogakṣemakṛtye kṣamante ||17|| evaṃ bhagavataḥ kuśalānuyogapuraḥsarīmamṛtāsārasarasāṃ sarasvatīmākarṇya sampūrṇamanorathānāṃ sumanasāṃ saṃsatpuṃse parasmai vijñāpayāmāsa | deva ! kathamakuśalamāvirbhavedbhavatā kṛtāvalambānāmasmākam? kintu | asti praśastavibhavairvibudhairalaṅghyā laṅketi nāma rajanīcararājadhānī | māṇikyamandirabhuvāṃ mahasāṃ prarohaiḥ tejastrayāya dinadīpadaśāṃ diśantī ||18|| enāṃ purāṇanagarīṃ nagarītisālāṃ sālābhirāmabhujanirjitayakṣarājaḥ | helābhibhūtajagatāṃ rajanīcarāṇāṃ rājā cirādavati rāvaṇanāmadheyaḥ ||19|| yadbāhurāhurasanāyitaśastradhārāḥ dikpālakīrtimayacandramasaṃ grasanti | yadvairiṇāṃ raṇamukhe śaraṇapradāyī naivāsti kaścidamumantakamantareṇa ||20|| ambhojasambhavamamuṃ bahubhistapobhiḥ ārādhayan varamavāpa parairdurāpam | tasmādaśeṣabhuvanaṃ nijaśāsanasya lakṣyīkaroti rajanīcaracakravartī ||21|| tena vayaṃ parādhīnā iva bhavāmaḥ | tathā hi so'yaṃ kadācit krīḍādharādharamāruhya sāvarodhavadhūjanaścaraṇābhyāṃ sañcareta cedāgamiṣyatyāga ityanāviṣkṛtātapo bhayena bhagavān sahasrabhānurapi saṅkucitabhānureva tatsānūni nūnaṃ saṃśrayate | eṣa mṛgāṅko'pi mṛgayāyāsapariśrāntiviśrāntyai sasambhramaṃ namajjanaparivṛte majjanagṛhābhimukhe daśamukhe tatratyavicitrataraśātakumbhastambhāgrapratyagrapratyuptasphaṭikaśilāśālabhañjikāpuñjakaratalakalitanijopalamayakalaśamukhādacchācchāmavicchinnadhārāmambudhārāṃ nijakarābhimarśādāpādayaṃstasya prasādapiśunānāṃ śunāsīracirakāṅkṣitānāṃ viṃśatividhavīkṣaṇānāṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ pātraṃ bhavati | tena pulastyanandanena saṅkrandananandanātsvamandirodyānamānītasya mandārapramukhasya vṛndārakataruvṛndasya bandīkṛtasurasundarīnayanendīvaradvandvācca karāravindakalitakanakakalaśācca mandoṣṇaṃ syandamānairambubhirjambālitālavālasya pacelimānāmapi kusumānāṃ patanabhayamāśaṅkamānāḥ pavamānāḥ parispanditumapi prabhavo na bhavanti | ete'pi pāvakā rūḍhiśaṅkāvahāṃ hutavahākhyāṃ vahantastadgṛhe gārhapatyapurogāḥ paurogavadhuraṃ dadhate | kiṃ bahunā | sa eṣa mānuṣādavamānanamāgamiṣyatītyamanvānastaditarairavadhyatvaṃ caturānanavarāllabdhvā samuddhataḥ samprati samprahārasamākrāntadigantadantāvaladantakuntavraṇakiṇasthapuṭitavakṣaḥsthalaḥ sthalakamalinīṃ vanavāraṇa iva rāvaṇastrilokīmabhibhavan bhavadīyānityasmānna jātu kiñcidapi jānātīti | atha bhagavānākarṇya gīrvāṇagaṇavāṇīm indranīlācalodañcaccandrikādhavalasmitaḥ | vācamūce sudhādhārāṃ madhurāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ||22|| bhavatāmaparādhavidhāyinastasya yātudhānasya nidhanamadhunaiva vidhātuṃ śakyam | kintu sarasijāsanaśāsanamapyamoghīkurvannurvītale putrīyataḥ sutrāmamitrasya daśarathasya manorathamapi pūrayitumādṛtamānuṣaveṣaḥ sannahameva taṃ haniṣyāmīti vyāhṛtyāntaradhāt | tataḥ sā pariṣadanimiṣāṇāmunmiṣitaharṣā hṛṣīkeśādeśātpraśamitadurdaśāni nirdaśānanāni caturdaśabhuvanāni buddhvā dugdhasāgarānniragāt | tatastānamarān prāha sma pitāmahaḥ | bhavantastāvadavatariṣyato lakṣmīsahāyasya sāhāyyārthamapsaraḥprabhṛtiṣu yuvatiṣu vānarācchabhallagopucchanīlamukhaveṣabhṛtaḥ prathitaprabhāvāḥ prajāḥ prajanayeyuriti | puraiva kila mama jṛmbhārambhe sambhūtavāñjāmbavāniti | tataste gīrvāṇāstathākurvan | atha vaitānādvaiśvānarānnaraḥ prājāpatyaḥ sahemapātraḥ kaścidutthāya putrīyate daśarathāya pāyasamamṛtaprāyaṃ prāyacchat | kausalyāyai prathamamadiśadbhūpatiḥ pāyasārdham prādādardhaṃ praṇayamadhuraṃ kekayendrasya putryai | ete devyau taralamanasaḥ patyurālocya bhāvam svārdhāṃśābhyāṃ svayamakurutāṃ pūrṇakāmāṃ sumitrām ||23|| avabhṛthe'vasite sarayūtaṭād atha yathāyathamuccalite jane | daśarathaḥ paripūrṇamanorathaḥ puramagātpuruhūtapuropamām ||24|| apāṭavāt kevalamaṅgakānāṃ manojñakāntermahiṣījanasya | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ projjhitabhūṣaṇāni cakāśire dauhṛdalakṣaṇāni ||25|| mandamandamapayadvalitrayā gādhatāviṣayanābhigahvarā | kosalendraduhituḥ śanairabhūt madhyayaṣṭirapi dṛṣṭigocarā ||26|| nyagrodhapatrasamatāṃ kramaśaḥ prayātām aṅgīcakāra punarapyudaraṃ kṛśāṅgyāḥ | jīvātave daśamukhoragapīḍitānāṃ garbhacchalena vasatā prathamena puṃsā ||27|| madhyaṃ tanutvādavibhāvyamānam ākāśamāsīdasitāyatākṣyāḥ | garbhodaye viṣṇupadāpadeśāt kārśyaṃ vihāyāpi vihāya eva ||28|| uccasthe grahapañcake suragurau sendau navamyāṃ tithau lagne karkaṭake punarvasuyute meṣaṃ gate pūṣaṇi | nirdagdhuṃ nikhilāḥ palāśasamidho medhyādayodhyāraṇeḥ āvirbhūtamabhūtapūrvamaparaṃ yatkiñcidekaṃ mahaḥ ||29|| atha rāmābhidhānena kaveḥ surabhayan giraḥ | alañcakāra kāruṇyād raghūṇāmanvayaṃ hariḥ ||30|| tamenamanvajāyanta trayastretāgnitejasaḥ | agrajasyānukurvantastairtairlokottarairguṇaiḥ ||31|| bharatasteṣu kaikeyyāstanayo vinayojjvalaḥ | anyau lakṣmaṇaśatrughnau sumitrāyāṃ kṛtodayau ||32|| ete vavṛdhire vīrā brahmakṣemāya dīkṣitāḥ | lokānandamukundasya catvāra iva bāhavaḥ ||33|| atha kadācidaparimeyamāyābhayānakayuddhasamuddhatadaityabalāvaskandakāndiśīkavṛndārakānīkaparivāryamāṇarathaḥ paṅktirathastapaścaryājātānāmāścaryāṇāmāyatanaṃ triśaṅkuyājinaṃ bhagavantaṃ padyaprabandhamiva darśitasargabhedaṃ prākṛtavyākaraṇamiva prakaṭitavarṇavyatyāsaṃ budhamiva somasutaṃ kuśikasutamadrākṣīt | tadanu yathāvidhi kṛtasaparyeṇa maryādātītamahimnā mahitena gādhetarahṛdayena gādhinandanena satraparitrāṇārthamitthamabhyarthito'bhūt | rājan bhavatastanayena vinayābhirāmeṇa rāmeṇa śarāsanamitreṇa saumitrimātraparijanena kriyamāṇakraturakṣo rakṣoduritamuttīrya kṛtāvabhṛtho bhavitumabhilaṣāmīti | etadākarṇya karṇaparuṣaṃ maharṣibhāṣitamatimātraputravātsalyāt kausalyājāniḥ saśalyāntaḥkaraṇo'bhūt| tatastasmin bahuprakārairavāryaniścaye bhagavati viśvāmitre daśarathastapanakulahitena purohitenaivamabhihito'bhūt | paryāptabhāgyāya bhavānamuṣmai kuryātsaparyāṃ kuśikātmajāya | niryātudhānāṃ vasudhāṃ vidhātuṃ niryātu rāmaḥ saha lakṣmaṇena || 34 || evaṃ vasiṣṭhena pratiṣṭhāpitadhṛtirdaśarathaḥ sutapradānena kuśikasutamanorathameva pūrayāmāsa | yogena labhyo yaḥ puṃsāṃ saṃsārāpetacetasām | niyogena pituḥ so'yaṃ rāmaḥ kauśikamanvagāt || 35 || tatra satraṃ paritrātuṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ | saumitrisahitaṃ rāmaṃ nayannayamavocata || 36 || balena tapasāṃ labdhe baletyatibaleti ca | vidyete mayi kākutstha vidye te vitarāmi te || 37 || tato gṛhītavidyasya dāśaratheḥ pradeśamekaṃ pradarśya bhagavānitthamakathayat | asminpurā purabhidaḥ parameśvarasya phālāntarālanayanajvalane manobhūḥ | sadyaḥ prapadya śalabhatvamamuñcadaṅgaṃ tasmādamuṃ janapadaṃ viduraṅgasaṃjñam || 38 || tadanu mānasasaraḥprasṛtāṃ sarayūmatikramya vṛtravadhapravṛddhavṛddhaśravaḥpaṅkakṣālanalabdhamalayormaladakarūṣanāmnorjanapadayoḥ sīmni kṛtapadayordāśarathyoḥ punarapyevamabravīt | yakṣaḥ suketurdruhiṇaprasādāllebhe sutāṃ kāmapi tāṭakākhyām | sundaḥ kilaināṃ pariṇīya tasyāṃ mārīcanīcaṃ janayāmbabhūva || 39 || ekadā sunde nihate mārīcaḥ kumbhasambhavamabhibhūya tasya śāpādavāpa kauṇapatām | tāṭakāpyabhūtpuruṣādinī | seyamabjāsanasiddhasindhurasahasraprāṇātmajena saha janapadavipadaṃ vidadhānā vyāpādanīyā tvayeti | rāmastamākarṇya strīvadhaśaṅkāmakarot | kiñca vairocanīṃ mantharāṃ vasundharāparādhadhurandharāṃ purandareṇa nihatāṃ janārdanakṛtamardanāṃ ca bhārgavajananīṃ pradarśya dāśaratheramandāṃ sundavadhūvadhavicikitsāmutsārayāmāsa | āśrutaḥ śrutavṛttena tena sundapriyāvadhaḥ | tamevānvavadattasya cāpaḥ śiñjāravacchalāt || 40 || tatkāle piśitāśanāśapiśunā sandhyeva kācinmuneradhvānaṃ tarasā rurodha rudhirakṣodāruṇā dāruṇā | svādhīne hanane purīṃ vidadhatī mṛtyoḥ svakṛtyātyayakrīḍatkiṅkarasaṅghasaṅkaṭamahāśṛṅgāṭakāṃ tāṭakā || 41 || atha dāśaratheḥ karṇamaviśattāṭakāguṇaḥ | tathā dhanurguṇastūrṇaṃ prāviśattajjighāṃsayā ||42|| tato bhāvini saṅgrāme baddhaśraddhasya tāṭakā | svaprāṇān rāmabāṇasya vīrapāṇamakalpayat || 43 || munirbhṛśāśvopajñāni tāṭakāmāthine dadau | astrāṇi jṛmbhakādīni jambhaśāsanaśāsanāt || 44 || tatra kañcana viriñcilokapratyādeśaṃ pradeśaṃ pradarśayannavocat | pratidinamavadātairbrahmabhirbrahmaniṣṭhaiḥ praśamitabhavakhedaiḥ sādaraṃ sevyamāne | baliniyamanahetorvāmanaḥ kānane'smin baliniyamaparassan brahmacārī cacāra ||45|| apahṛtavibudhārtervāmanasyājamūrterakhilabhuvanabhikṣorāśramānokahānām | tatiriyamatinīlā vyāptadigvyomasīmā svayamapi parimātuṃ lokamabhyudyateva ||46|| iti vividharasābhiḥ kauśikavyāhṛtābhiḥ śrutipathamadhurābhiḥ pāvanībhiḥ kathābhiḥ | galitagahanakṛcchraṃ gacchatordāśarathyoḥ samakucadiva sadyastādṛśaṃ mārgadairghyam ||47|| tataḥ siddhāśramaṃ praviśya viśvāmitraḥ satramārabhata | tadanantaramantarikṣāntarālādāpatantamantakānīkabhayānakaṃ taṃ palāśagaṇamavalokya palāyamānāḥ karagalitasamitkuśāḥ kuśikanandanāntevāsinaḥ sasambhramamabhilaṣitāhavāya rāghavāya nyavedayan | hṛtvādreḥ śikharāṇi tāni paritaḥ kṣiptvā hasitvā krudhā kṛtvā hastavighaṭṭanaṃ tata itaḥ sthitvā naṭitvā muhuḥ | siktvā kṣmāmasṛjā srajāntrakṛtayā baddhvā kacān khecarān dagdhvāgneḥ sadṛśā dṛśā niśicarā rundhanti randhraṃ divaḥ ||48|| saṅkrāntavarṇāntaragādhisūnoḥ samparkapuṇyādiva rāmabhadraḥ | kṣātrakramāt pippaladaṇḍayogyaḥ palāśadaṇḍādṛtapāṇirāsīt ||49|| mārīcanīcamatirāhavamāracayya kṣiptaḥ kṣaṇena raghunāyakasāyakena | madhyepayonidhi bhayena nimagnamūrtirveṣaṃ pupoṣa jalamānuṣanirviśeṣam ||50|| subāhurāhavonmattaḥ kṛttaḥ kākutsthapatriṇā | munīnāmanabhipretaḥ pretanāthātithiḥ kṛtaḥ || 51 || vaṃśaspṛśā hṛdayahāriphalānvitena rāmeritena sahasā saha sāyakena | snehārditena niragādanurāgiṇīva prāṇāvalirhṛdayataḥ piśitāśanānām || 52 || atha niśicaramāthādvītavaitānavighnaḥ muniravabhṛthakṛtyaṃ viśvahṛdyaṃ samāpya | amanuta jayalakṣmyā rāmamājau sametaṃ yajanajanitamūrtyā yoktumavyājalakṣmyā || 53 || atha mithilāṃ prati prasthitaḥ kauśikaḥ kākutsthamitthamakathayat | purā khalu kuśeśayāsanajanmā kuśābhidhāno rājarṣiḥ kuśāmbapramukhaiścaturbhiḥ kauśāmbīmahodayadharmāraṇyagirivrajākhyānāṃ purīṇāṃ kartṛbhiḥ putrī babhūva | kuśanābhastu ghṛtīcyāṃ kanyāśatamajanayat | kanyāstāḥ saṃnaddhayauvanāḥ kāmayamānaḥ pavamānaḥ pratyākhyānātpratyāpannamanyurāsāmavayaveṣvanārjavamatanuta | atha niyatamaparihāryā yā jarā sā madaṅge vikacakamalapaṇḍe candrikevāvirāsīt ||3|| tasmātsamastakṣatravargagarvapāṭana variṣṭadhārāparaśvadhabharaṇabhīṣaṇaveṣabhārgavabhaṅgādaparicchinnataraśauryaśālini saundaryabhājane janānurāganilaye nirmatsare vatsale vatse'sminviśvambharābhāraṃ cirakāladhāryamāṇamāryairanumataḥ sannavatārya viśrāntisukhamanubhavitumabhilaṣāmiti | tataḥ prāvṛṣeṇyapayovāhavyūhastanitanādākarṇanasamudīrṇaniratiśayāhlādasaṃsarganirargalanirgalatkekālāpinaḥ kalāpinaḥ iva janāḥ pramadabhavakalakalaravamukharitaharinmukhā vabhūvuḥ | ānandavāṣpavisaro vadane prajānāmāvirbabhūva makaranda ivāravinde | rāmasya kāntimabhiṣekadine bhavitriṃ prakṣālya cakṣuriva vīkṣitumādareṇa || 4|| rājāpi teṣāṃ saṃpatsyamānamahotsavotsukajanasaṃmardajaniṣyamāṇarajorājipātaparijihīrṣayeva romāñcaprapañcena kañcukitāṅgānāṃ pramāṇātītāṃ prītiṃ prapannānāṃ harṣaprakarṣeṇa dviguṇīkṛtamānandamantarniyamya sumantapramukhān mantrīmukhyānevamācakhyau | asmānanāśritatapovanabhūmibhāgānunmucyamārga paripālanajāgarukām | amlānamaugdhyamacirādavalambya rāmamevaṃvidhaḥ kathamudite janānurāgaḥ ||5|| te'pi niyamitanijamanorathāya jaśarathāya savinayamevaṃ vyajijñapan | deve sthite'pi tanayaṃ tavarāmabhadraṃ lokaḥ svayaṃ bhajatu nāma kimatra citram | candraṃ vinā yadupalambhanahetubhūtaṃ kṣīrodamāśrayati kiṃ tṛṣitaścakoraḥ ||6|| tadanantaratatvare tatparastatvavidāṃ variṣṭhasya vaśiṣṭhasya śāsanādabhiṣekopakaraṇāharaṇāya sāmātyaḥ pauravargaḥ | āhūya rāmaṃ vinayābhirāmamāviḥ pramodaḥ prabhurevamūce | tavottamāṅge mukuṭaṃ vidhātumahnāya tiṣye divase yatiṣye ||7|| atha daśarathamanorathaṃ kauśalyāyai nivedya svabhavanamupāgatasya rāmasya bhagavān vaśiṣṭhaḥ sañjātakautukaḥ kautukamaṅgalaṃ nivartayāmāsa | āpūrayanmaṅgalatūryaghoṣairāśāvaśāvallabhakarṇatālam | ujjṛmbhitaḥ ko'pi girāmabhūmirunmastakaḥ paurajanapramodaḥ ||8|| yāmevāhurniśicarakulonmūlane mūlahetuṃ yasyāścittaṃ prakṛtikuṭilaṃ gātramitraṃ babhūva | ambhojinyāḥ śiśirasarasaṃ kāsarīvācchamambhaḥ kaikeyyāḥ sā hṛdayamadayaṃ mantharā nirmamantha ||9|| alaghucalitajhañjhāvātaniṣpeṣadoṣādaśaniriva kaṭhoraḥ śītalāmbhodapaṅkau | apahṛtajanasaukhyānmantharābhedavākyādapi bharatajananyāṃ hanta daurjanyamāsīt ||10|| saiṣā mantharābhidhānapiśācikāveśaparavaśanijāśayā pūrvaṃ daṇḍake vaijayantapuravāstavyaśambarāsurasaṃgarasaṃgatavedanāpanodanāthamātmane vitīrṇa varāya daśarathāya varadvayaṃ nyavedayat | tayorākasya saṃrambho bharatasyabhiṣecanam | anyasya vanyavṛttyaiva vane rāmasya vartanam ||11|| tasmin kṣaṇe varayugaṃ cirataptatāmranārācavādhaparuṣaṃ śravasī vidārya | satyaprahāṇacakitasya nṛpasya kāmamūrīcakāra hṛdaye puṭapākarītim ||12|| tanayavirahavārtāmātrasaṃtaptamānādatha daśarathacittāccetanā nirjagāma | davahutavaharocirjvālayā lehyamānājjhaṭiti gahanaguhādujjhihānā mṛgīva ||13|| atha daśarathaḥ kathamapi labdhasaṃjñaḥ kaikeyīmabhāṣata | rāmaḥ kāmamupāśriyati vanaṃ tyaktvā dhṛtaṃ kautukam lokastyakṣati kautukaṃ ciradhṛtaṃ tasyābhiṣeke katham | dharmāpāyabhayena vatsavirahaṃ vakṣyāmi vakṣyāmi kiṃ yāvatkalpamakīrtirārtijananī jāyeta jāye tava ||14|| vatsaṃ kaṭhorahṛdaye nayanābhirāmaṃ rāmaṃ vinā na khalu tiṣṭhati jīvītaṃ me | dhāturvalādupayamastvayi jātapūrvaḥ kaikeyi māmupayamaṃ nayatīti manye ||15|| tadanu nijamanorathaikaparipūraṇe kṛtādarā kaikeyīsopahāsamavādīt | satyaviplavamapatyasaṃgataḥ saṃgataṃ bhṛśamapaśayatastava | āśrutasya viphalatvamasti cedāśrutasya racito'yamañjaliḥ ||16|| kiṃ nāgataste śravasoḥ sakāśamariṃdamaḥ satyagirāṃ purogaḥ | śyenāmiṣībhūtakapotapotajīvātave śastranikṛttagātraḥ ||17|| kiñca abhyarcya kasmaicidupāśritāya vitīrya viprāya vilocane sve | āpūrayatkaścidalarkasaṃjñaḥ prājñaḥ pratijñā prathitaprabhāvaḥ ||18|| asurasamaravelājātabādhāvasāne varayugamadiśastvaṃ prītipūrvaṃ yathā me | aśithilaruṇavandhāḥ satyasandhā narendrā jalalipiriti kāmaṃ saṃgarantāṃ giraṃ tām ||19|| kiṃ bahunā satyodyāṃ giramiha nirvahasva mā vā sammānaṃ bhuvi na saheya rāmamātuḥ | saṃsthāsye viṣamupabhujya paśyataste saṃnāhaṃ tyajasi na cetpravartamānam ||20|| evaṃ vādīnīmenāṃ bhūyo'pi bhūpatiravadat | ayi kaṭhinahṛdaye kimunmuktalokamaryadayā dayāpetayātvayeti | naivābhavastvamiha śīlavatīṣu gaṇyā naivābhajatpitṛmatāṃ gaṇanā sa rāmaḥ | naivāpamātmajasukhānyahamapyanārye naivāpamambu bharatena na me pradeyam ||21|| kiñca vāsastvacāṃ bhavatu kiñcana tāravīṇāṃ chāyādrumāśca bhavanāni bhavantu dhanyāḥ | kaikeyi tasya śayanāni kathaṃ bhaveyustvaccetaso'pi kaṭhināni śilātalāni ||22|| evaṃ bhartrā bhartsitāpyārdracittā nābhūdeṣā mantharākrāntavṛttiḥ | rākācandre rājamānepyavādhaṃ vīrucchannā candrakāntasthalīva ||23|| tadanu muhūrtamātramapi rāmamukhāvalokanasukhamanububhuṣurdaśarathaḥ kumāramānayeti sumantramādideśa | tena satvaraṃ rājabhavanapraviśito rāmaḥ kṛtapraṇāmaḥ pitaramathābhūtamukhavikāsamārādālakṣya cakitaḥ kimidamiti kaikeyīmanvayuṅktaḥ | sāpi pāpāśayā pratyavādīt | vatsa, pratiśrutavaradvayanirvahaṇe nipuṇetarastātaste samprati sānuśayastanayavātsalyātsatyavyatyāsatrāsācca gāḍhamagādhe śokasāgare nimajjatīti | varadvayaṃ tāvattava munivṛttyaiva vane vartanamavaneravanaṃ bharatasyeti | rāmastadākarṇya pramuditahṛdayaḥ kṛtāñjatirenāṃ prati vyajjñapat | bhīto bhūbharataḥ kimamba bharataḥ kiṃvā vanātpāvanāttrasto'haṃ sagarānvavāyakakudastātaḥ kutaḥ śocati | divyāyāḥ sarito nivāpakaraṇālladhvīṃ pratijñāmimāmāvābhyāmabhipūrayiṣyanti na cetputrī kathaṃ syādayam ||24|| vanabhuvi tanumātratrāṇamājñāpitaṃ me sakalabuvanabhāraḥ sthāpito vatsamūrdhni | tadiha sukaratāyāmāvayostarkitāyāṃ mayi patati garīyānamamba te pakṣapātaḥ ||25|| tātaḥ svavācā vyavahṛtya hṛdyaṃ vatsābhiṣekotsavamaṅgalaṃ me | praṇāmasaṃjñasya mayārpitasya kiṃ pūrṇapātrasya na pātramāsīt ||26|| tatkṣaṇamaśanihata iva parvataḥ sarvataḥ parītadavadahana iva vanaspatiḥ divaspatipadabhraṃśavidhura iva nahuṣaḥ papāta nāḥsajñya paṅktirathaḥ | tataḥ sā pitṛnirdeśamācareti rāmamādideśa | māturājñāṃ vahanmūrdhnā mālāmiva mahāyaśāḥ | vanāya rāma vavrāja jagatāmavanāya ca ||27|| asau samāsādya sadyaḥ kausalyasadanamabhiṣekapratibandhaṃ kaikeyīnirbandhamātmanaśca vanavāsaṃ praṇāmānantaraṃ tasyai nyavedayat | saitadākarṇya vidīrṇahṛdayā viṣadigdhamukhaśilīmukhaviddhaśravaṇayugaleva sahasā nipatya vilalāpa | rekhārathāṅgasarasīruhaśaṅkhacihne kṣemakare tavakare jagatāṃ trayāṇām | kāntārakandakhananaṃ racayati nūnamāvaddhavānpratisaraṃ bhagavānvaśiṣṭhaḥ ||28|| tatrasaumitriratimātrapravṛddhamanyuḥśatamanyasamānamevamagrajamakathayat | ārya, akāryamidaṃ lokagarhaṇārhāyāḥ kaikeyyā vacasā rajasā jarasā ca samākrāntasvāntatayā kṛtyākṛtyavivekamūkasya rājñaḥ prajñāśaithilyānniḥsṛtena vacasā santyajya rājyamaṭavīparyaṭanaṃ vidhātum | kintu tubhyamanabhyarthamānāya prathamameva pitrā pradattā nanu pṛthāvī | kṣatradharmo'pi dharmyātpathaḥ pramādyāpi varṇāśramarakṣaṇataḥ samīcīnaḥ prayeṇa puruṣaṃ niḥśreyase niyojayet | niyataṃ niyatibalamatilaṅghya pauruṣameva dhīrasya puruṣārthānsamarthayet | mābhūttvatpadapadmayoraruṇimā kāntārasañcārataḥ pāṇaupālimā manākprasaratu jyākarṇādeva me | kaikeyīparībhūtatātavacane namrobhavānmā sma bhūtkiñcinmāmakamārya śauryajaladhe namraṃ dhanurvartatām ||29||
evamācakṣāṇaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmaḥ sāntvayannevāvocat | vatsa savitṛvaṃśajātānāṃ pitṛnirdeśa eva deśikaḥ sarvasarmasu | bahavaḥ khalu pitṛnirdeśagauravādgohatyāmapi mātṛvadhamapi tāruṇyavinimayamapi kaṇḍuraiṇukeyapuruprabhṛtayaḥ kurvāṇā nirvicāramācāravatāmagraṇyā iti gaṇyate | tasmādavaśyaṃ vaśyaṃ eva pituravagāhe gahananiti | tatra vistṛtaputravātsalyā kausalyā tena saha gantumabhilaṣantī kṛtapraṇāmena rāmeṇa savinayamevamabhihitā | kāntārabhāji mayi kekeyarājaputryāḥ kārkaśyakandalutayā dalitasya vācā | tātasya śokadahanaglapitaṃ śarīraṃ mātastvayā na kadācidupekṣaṇīyam ||30|| tataḥ sā tanayasya svastyayanāya samastadevatākīrtanapuraḥsarīmāśiṣamācacakṣe | tadanu rāmastāmabhivandya niṣkrāntaḥ prakāntanepathyāyāḥ sītāyāḥ prasādamāsasāda | kalyāṇavādasukhitāṃ sahasaiva kāntāṃ kāntāracārakathayā kaluṣīcakāra | ambhodanādamuditāṃ vipine mayūrīṃ saṃtrāsayanniva dhanurdhvaninā pulindaḥ ||31|| ayamenāmanugantumupakrāntāmakathayat | priye janakanandini prakṛtipeśalāmīdṛśīṃ kathaṃ glapayituṃ sahe tava śirīṣamṛdvīṃ tanum | gṛhītahariṇīgaṇatrikavisārinānāśirākṣatakṣaritaśoṇitānanevṛkānane kānane ||32|| tadanu nānāvidhaprayatnenāpyanunmiṣadanujigamiṣāsaaithilyāṃ maithilyāṃ lakṣmaṇe'pyanavasitānugamanavyavasāye vāsiṣṭhāya suyajñāya bhūṣaṇamaśeṣaṃ nāgasahasreṇa saha śatruñjayāhvayaṃ mātuladattaṃ mattahastinamagastyakauśikābhyāṃ ca mahārghāni ratnāni vitīrya tadanu nirjarārivīryanuṣī dhanuṣī nirapāyatrāṇakarmaṇī varmaṇī nirmaryādaśilīmukhakṛtānuṣaṅgau nisaṅgau nirvartitavīrapāṇau kṛpāṇau varuṇena jalakasadasi dattametatsamastamāyudhajātamādāya māmanugacchateti saumitrimanvagrahīt | sītāpi nijābharaṇajātaṃ suyajñapatnyai nyadāt | tataḥ saumitrirapi svādhīnena dhanena kañcit kausalyāśritamupādhyāyamatoṣayat | tatra sakuṭumabāya trijaṭābhidhānāya nirdhanāya dvijātaye svahastanikṣiptadaṇḍapatitadeśāvadhikaṃ godhanaṃ ca kapiñjalādibhyo dvijātibhyaśca radhupatirvittāni vividhāni vitatāra | tataste pauranārīṇāṃ niḥśvāsajhañjhānilacaladadharakiśalayānāmasrasalilāsāreṇa śokapāvakena ca vapuṃṣi manṃsi ca siktvā dagdhvā ca niṣiddhaparijanānugamanatayā prakāśitapravāsa siddhāntāḥ śuddhāntānniścakramuḥ | sītā purā gaganacāribhirapyadṛṣṭā mā bhūdiyaṃ sakalamānavanetrapātram | ityākalya niyataṃ pidadhe vidhātā vāṣpodayena nayanāni śarīrabhājām ||33|| ruddhāpi yāntamanugacchati maithilī māṃ vatso jahāti na kadācana lakṣmaṇo'pi | ityetayoranugatiṃ prativodhya gantuṃ bhūyo'pi rājabhavanaṃ praviveṣa rāmaḥ ||34|| tasminsumantreṇa vijñāya pradarśite būpatirbhūtāviṣṭa iva viṣṭarānnipatya sadāraḥ sadāracitaparidevanā vanotkaṇṭhāṃ svayamapyakarot | tadā sumantraḥ kaikeyīmavravīt | devi, virama rāmābhiṣekasamunmiṣitāhlādāṅkurāvagrahādāgrahāt | purā khalu varaprasādādavagatasakalaprāṇibhāṣaṇatayā paryaṅkaparyantaparisaratpipīlikālāpe tava pitaraṃ hasanakāraṇaṃ pṛṣṭvā tadvivaraṇaṃ patyurmaraṇakaraṇamityavetyāpi bhūyaso nirbandhātkupitena rājñāvajñātāyā mātuste mānukurvīthā iti | kṛtāsamañjaniryāsaṃ sagaraṃ kekayātmajā nidarśanatve nirdiśya nirabadhnānnijaṃ patim ||35|| siddhārthako mahāmātyastatparityāgamabravīt | sarayupātitānekaprajāmaraṇakāraṇāt ||36|| atha daśarathena rāmaḥ saparicchada eva gaccheti nirdiṣṭaḥ kevalaṃ khanitrapiṭakau valkalayugalaṃ ca prārthayata | sukhocitānāṃ suvyaktadivyalāvaṇyasampadām | trayāṇāmapi kaikeyī valkalādīnyupāharat ||37|| atha radhukulanātho madhyamāmbāniyogādguṇavati paridhāne maṅgalārhe nirāśaḥ | adhikucataṭavalgajjānakībāṣpasekādapagatakharabhāvaṃ valkalaṃ paryadhatta ||38|| tatrācitrīyanta sarve nirvikāravadanalakṣmikamikṣvākukulādhyakṣamadhyakṣayantasteṣāmeva śokaśaṅkukīlitamānasānāmānaneṣu pāramparyeṇāsphuradvikāraḥ | savalkale dāśarathau viṣādādāmīlitākṣo yadabhūdvaśiṣṭhaḥ | tadeva jātaṃ karaṇaṃ maharṣeḥ kākusthyayāthārthyavilokanasya ||39|| asya pītāmbaratyāge kiṃ jātā vikriyā'purā | iti pratyagdṛśāṃ śreṣṭho vaśiṣṭho nātivivyathe ||40||
so'yaṃ maithilīvalkaladhāraṇamaruṇadaruṇasārathikulaguruḥ | tatra prayāṇāya praṇipatantīṃ snuṣāmāśliṣya prasnutaputravātsalyā kausalyā bāṣpagadgadamabhavat | gharme nidāghakiraṇasya karaiḥ kaṭhoraiḥ kāntāramadhyapadavīṣu nakhaṃpacāsu | tvāṃ vīkṣya saṃsthulapadāṃ vanadevatābhirnindiṣyante niyatameva nimeṣahāniḥ || 41|| atha maithilīnāthaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ sapradakṣiṇaṃ rājānaṃ jananījanaṃ ca praṇamya pratisiddhapratihāracakro niścakrāma | ratho'pi daśarathājñāparatantreṇa sumantreṇa dvāri samānītaḥ | prārabdhayātrasya raghūdvahasya prāgeva sītā rathamāruroha | ānīlarathyaṃ rathamārurukṣorahnāṃ prabhoragrasarī prabheva ||42|| dāśarathī ca rathamāruruhatuḥ | yathā yathā rāghavarājadhānīṃ vihāya sītā vipinotsukābhūt | tathā tathājāyata yātukāmā laṅkāṃ vinā rākṣasarājalakṣmīḥ ||43|| āvālavṛddhamanugacchati rāmabhadrameṣā purī tadiha mā khalu nirguṇā syāma | ityādarādiva dharā bahudhā vidhāyadhūlicchalānnijatanuṃ tamanupratasthe ||44|| nṛpasukhavimukhena svena kāntena sākaṃ duhitari vidhipākātkānanāya vrajantyām | akuśalamiti matvā nūnamahnāya dhātrī parajanamukhavāṣpaṃ pāṃśubhiḥ paryahārṣīt ||45|| rāmānusārarasanirgatapauravargā saṃsthānamātragṛhacatvararājamārgā | nirmuktabhogabhujagatvagiva kṣaṇena laghvī babhūva raghupuṅgavarājadhānī ||46|| atha daśarathaḥ sāntaḥpurajanaḥ purānnigartya gatyantarābhāvāttameva rāmaṃ suricamā lokayannālakapathamatikrānte sumantrākrāntasyandane radhunandane syandamānabāṣpapravāho mohamupagamya bhūmyāṃ papāta | tataḥ parajanakṛtāśvāsāllabdhasaṃjñāya rājñe sausalyāsadanamarocata | atha dāśarathirahamahamikayā sammūrcchanmahājanaughaduravagāhatayā mandāyamānasyandanavegaḥ sakalajanavivekakokanadaṃ mukulayan mohatamasā tamasātaṭamupagamat | āviḥ pralāpamaṭavīṃ bhajato janasya kākusthapādavirahāsadamānasasya | āstīrṇaparṇaśayanānyabhavangṛhāṇi mūlasthalāni tamasātaṭabhūruhāṇām ||47|| atha niśīthe dāśarathiḥ sumantreṇa samantrya vañcitajanasaṃhatirakativinatānandanena syandanena vdaśrutigomatīniṣyandikānāmanadītrayapariṣkṛtāmikṣvākavemanunā dattā vasumatīmatītya vividhavanagahanavīruttṛṇapaṭalapihitarathaturagakhuramudrayā padavyā gaṅgātaraṅgasaṅgatarumūlaṃ gaganagaṅgāliṅgataśṛṅga śṛṅgaverapurālaṃkāramiṅgudīpādapamupāgamat | dṛṣṭvā rāmamanekajanmaracitairdṛśyaṃ śubhaiḥ karmabhiḥ śrutvāmātṛvaradvayādupagatāṃ vṛttiṃ ca vaikhānasīm | atyujjṛmbhitaharṣaśokajanitairvāṣpairniṣādādhipaḥ śītāśītaguṇānvitairaviralaiḥ sampaktavaktro'bhavat ||48|| so'yaṃ priyasuhṛtsamāsādya guhaḥ kṛtāñjalirañjasā raghunāthamanunāthitavān | deva, pitṛniyogapravaṇāntaḥkaraṇamapi bhavantaḥ vijñāpayitumajñajā napadarītirbhāratī māṃ mukharayati | astyetadanivāryavīryodbhaṭa bhaṭadurgavargayuktamanuṣaktabhogyajātamantharaṃ mantharāhṛdayatodāvahamasmadīyaṃ rājyam | tadetadanidampramathapravṛttaṃ parigṛhya kiñcidanugṛhya ca parijanayogya bhāgyabhājanamamuṃ janamamuñcanneva tātādeśaṃ deśesminvismayanīyānubhāvamunivṛnde mandākinīsandarśanena mandāyamānajananījanaviyogadurdarśaścaturdaśadaśarathakathitāḥ samāḥ samāpayatu bhavāniti | tasminnitthaṃ prārthanābhāji sakhyau pratyācakhyau rāmabhadraḥ priyoktyā | karṇikāranikurumbakarburaḥ | nirnimeṣagaṇabhāgyasaṃcayādunmimeṣa bhagavānuṣarbudhaḥ ||54|| etadvṛttāntamārakṣikarākṣasīgaṇagarvodīrṇavarṇitam ākarṇya dūyamānamānasā jānakī hutāśanamupasthāya ‘śīto || 61 || ādīpyamānapavanātmajavālasaṅgādaṅgāraśeṣavibhavāmavalokya laṅkām | vyomni sthitā niśicarāḥ svagṛhāṇi nūnaṃ nirvāpayanta iva netrabhavaiḥ payobhiḥ || 62 || cakre śakrajidājñayā raṇamukhe yatkarma rakṣogaṇastatkartuṃ kṣaṇadācarakṣitibhujā yukto'pyaśakto bhavet | saptārciśca hanūmatā paricito laṅkāmadhākṣīdyathā tatpitrā marutā yuto'pi na tathā dāhakriyāyāṃ paṭuḥ || 63 ||
